items.title: Pro Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pixel Creations presents: Pro Base! Have you overcome noob bases with dirt walls? Then you're ready for the awesome pro base with a few levels. In this base, you can become a pro player with all the necessary things. The first night is no longer a nightmare.

- 5 underground levels
- Secret room
- 6 HD skins
- Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Pastel Teens HD Skin Pack

+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: FOODS+
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Craft, bake, grill, and blend 65 *NEW* FOODS! Ever felt that the current food could use some more outcomes? Foods+ adds tons of new food recipes to make your survival experience better! Build a huge food city with tons of restaurants that comes with new foods!

+ 65 *NEW* FOODS!
+ Kitchen appliances!
+ All foods are craftable!

! Foods only usable with the world provided

items.title: Top 10 Trolls
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Levelatics presents: Top 10 Trolls! Have you always wanted to troll your friends but didn't know how? Check out the 10 epic traps presented in in-game examples and building tutorials so you can easily recreate them and nothing will stand in your way of playing a fun prank on your friends.

- 1 free skin included
- Licensed by Levelatics and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Luxury Cliffside Mansion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:

- 3 sports cars
- Private jet
- Jetski
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Dark Lava
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Deep in the lava pits of the Nether live scary and horrifying creatures! Watch your step because you are surrounded by lava and the creatures that live in it! Or join the dark lava side and become a menacing molten monster. These dark monsters crawling out of the lava look super cool and are perfect for your Nether adventures.

- 14 lava monster skins

Go all out with these cute and adorable skins that take you all the way back to the old days, making your look fabulous and trendy!
Switch between various skins and try out various different styles!

- 8 charming skins!
- 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Spanish 1: TNT Squad
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Learn Spanish by joining the TNT Defuser Squad. You'll learn Spanish numbers, color, and useful vocabulary in your quest to save the city.
- 56 vocabulary words
- Play 12 engaging levels
- Activity-based language education
- Spaced repetition
- Minigames to test your skills
- 5 skins included

Use your Spanish in this fun immersive game. Practice makes "perfecto"!
